subject: Trading
title: Setting Profit Targets
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Setting Profit Targets.

hook.text: You're up $500 in a trade. Do you take it or let it run? Without a preset target, greed and fear will decide.

buildup.text: Profit targets are predetermined exit points where you take gains. They're set before the trade, not during.

discovery.text: Targets can be based on chart levels, measured moves, risk multiples (2R, 3R), or Fibonacci extensions.

twist.text: Fixed targets leave money on the table in strong trends. But trailing exits leave money on the table in reversals.

climax.text: Many traders combine both: take partial profits at a target and trail the rest. Hybrid approaches capture both.

punchline.text: Know where you'll take profits before you trade.

quiz.question: When should profit targets be set?
